title: Print only the first line of command output
summary: Use sed to extract and display just the first line from the output of a command. This is helpful when you only need the header or the first result.

steps.explain: Pipe the output of a command to sed with the '-n' flag and the '1p' command to print only the first line.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command whose output you want to filter
